prerender._comment: Word and English pages are rendered on demand by worker/dictionary.ts (keeps dist under the 19,500-file budget). Only fixed pages are prerendered.

rhymePages._comment: A standalone /anupras/<word> page is built (and indexed) only for common, defined words with enough defined rhymes — keeps the site free of thin pages and the deploy small.

english._comment: English→Nepali pages prerendered for SEO (most frequent English words first). Others still work client-side.
